verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents running evals on every pull request and integrating experiments into CI/CD to catch regressions. It also offers a headless runner (`npx braintrust eval`, the `bt` CLI) suitable for pipelines, and markets the ability to "block bad releases before they hit production." Missing for 10: concrete documentation of the gating mechanism (score thresholds, failing exit codes, an official CI action or PR-comment integration) and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI gating.
